description: Data dictionary for vectorbt backtest trades and run metadata. Not strict JSON Schema (draft-07) — this is a structured documentation format; see 'json_schema_note' below if you need an actual validator-compatible version.
json_schema_note: To validate rows programmatically, wrap each table's 'columns' into a real JSON Schema object with 'properties' and a top-level 'required' array (not per-property booleans).

backtest_run.description: One row per backtest execution / parameter combination. Parent table for trades.

backtest_run_id.description: Unique id for this backtest run

trade_type.description: Which vectorbt trades_type this run's trade_book rows were extracted from. Required context — entry_trades/exit_trades/positions have different Return semantics.

vectorbt_version.description: Library version used, for reproducibility (backtest math has changed across vbt versions)

data_source.description: Vendor/exchange the OHLC data came from, e.g. Binance, yfinance, proprietary feed

random_seed.description: Seed used if strategy involves randomness (e.g. from_random_signals)

currency.description: Quote currency/asset for all monetary fields in this run, e.g. USDT, USD, INR

fee_model.description: How fees were configured in the backtest (fixed_fees vs fees vs custom)

fees_value.description: Fee value matching fee_model — fraction if PERCENTAGE, absolute if FIXED

benchmark_return.description: Buy-and-hold return over the same period, for reference

run_params.description: Normalized parameter grid values for a run. One row per (run, param) pair — avoids storing an untyped/unindexable JSON blob when sweeping arbitrary parameter shapes across strategies.

param_value.description: Stored as string; cast at query time. Keeps schema stable across strategies with different param shapes.

run_params.note: If your param set per strategy is small and fixed (e.g. always exactly fast_ma/slow_ma), promoting them to real typed columns on backtest_run is simpler and preferred over this table. Use this table only when param shape varies across strategies.

trade_book.description: One row per individual trade record produced by vectorbt, enriched with derived risk/excursion metrics. All rows in a given backtest_run_id share the same trade_type (see backtest_run.trade_type).

trade_id.description: Surrogate unique id across the whole table (not vectorbt's own Trade Id, which only resets per run)

vbt_trade_id.description: vectorbt's native 'Trade Id' within this run

parent_id.description: vectorbt's 'Parent Id' — links entry/exit trade fragments from the same scaled position. Required to reconstruct true position-level PnL on partial fills.

vbt_column.description: vectorbt's 'Column' field, flattened to a delimiter-joined string if it was a MultiIndex tuple (e.g. param combo + symbol). Document the delimiter used at ingestion time.

direction.description: Matches vectorbt's native casing exactly — do not re-case at ingestion.

entry_idx.description: Raw bar index of entry. Comes from pf.trades.records (raw array), NOT records_readable — not present in the readable dataframe.

exit_idx.description: Raw bar index of exit. Same caveat as entry_idx. Null if trade still open.

return_pct.note: Semantics differ between entry_trades/exit_trades/positions — see backtest_run.trade_type

exit_reason.description: Not natively provided by vectorbt (confirmed: records_readable has no exit-type field). Reconstructed by comparing exit_price against configured sl_stop/tp_stop within a tolerance.
exit_reason.reconstruction_tolerance_pct: Document the actual tolerance value used by your reconstruction script here at ingestion time.

risk_amount.requires: sl_stop must have been set for this run

max_favorable_excursion.description: Best unrealized price move during the trade window, from OHLC high/low slice between entry_idx and exit_idx.

max_adverse_excursion.description: Worst unrealized price move during the same window.

is_win.note: Prefer a SQL GENERATED ALWAYS AS column over storing this independently, to avoid drift if pnl is ever restated.

notes.description: Free-text annotation. Populated only when this table is unioned with a live trade_book (out of scope of this file) — leave null for pure backtest rows.

notes: trade_type on backtest_run must be set consistently — entry_trades, exit_trades, and positions have different Return semantics in vectorbt and should never be mixed within one run's trade_book rows.

vbt_source annotations mark fields that map 1:1 to a vectorbt records_readable column name; fields without vbt_source are either raw-record-only (entry_idx/exit_idx) or fully derived (derivation: computed_column).
Money fields are documented as 'number' for JSON portability, but should be stored as DECIMAL/NUMERIC (not FLOAT) in any SQL implementation to avoid rounding drift over large trade counts.
direction/status enums intentionally preserve vectorbt's native casing ('Long'/'Closed') rather than uppercasing, so raw ingestion from records_readable requires no transformation.
This table is designed to share column names with a live trade journal schema so backtest and live trades can eventually be UNIONed for direct comparison — that union table is not defined here.
